notes.claim: To rearrange a formula, start with the last operation and work back to the first, undoing each step with its inverse.
BBC Bitesize says solving a linear equation and changing the subject are exactly the same process, so the undoing in a flow diagram serves for both.
In one study of one-step equations, the most frequent errors were negative sign errors, followed by fractions errors.
A recorded wrong undo: a student reaches x/4 = 160 correctly, then divides instead of multiplying (called the "other inverse" error).
Balance scales have limits, and representing negative numbers on them can be challenging.
